stories.title: She left Canada to support ISIS. Now she's back and trying to rebuild a life
stories.summary: A young Canadian mother shares her memories of being an ISIS bride, and her harrowing escape from the extremist group.

stories.title: Trump's visit to Ireland for the Irish Open tees off with diplomatic controversy
stories.summary: President Trump heads to his golf club in Doonbeg while working in some Irish diplomacy.

stories.title: 25 years post 9/11, a grieving sister finds sense of peace at United 93 crash site
stories.summary: On September 11, 2001 Lori Guadagno lost her brother on flight United 93. 25 years later, the crash site is a place where she feels a sense of connection that she can't find anywhere else.

stories.title: Ringing in the Jewish new year with a twist on a Rosh Hashanah classic
stories.summary: Pati Jinich is a renowned chef and cookbook author. She was born in Mexico to a Jewish family, and her marzipan-stuffed challah bread blends her cultures in an exciting and delicious way.

stories.title: The other side of 9/11: Afghans reckon with America's long shadow
stories.summary: It's been nearly 25 years since the start of the U.S- led invasion of Afghanistan. NPR returns to Kabul to see how Afghans, now back under Taliban rule, are coping with the legacy of that 20 year war.

stories.title: What it takes to make a new — branded — tomato
stories.summary: Why is the grocery store produce aisle filling up with branded fruits and vegetables, like honeycrisp apples and cuties oranges? We watch the effort to make one new — branded — tomato.
